garbled_execution.input_transfer: Both labels for each evaluator input are sent openly. This reveals the global delta. Oblivious transfer and private input security are excluded.
garbled_execution.memory_method: The reusable label arena and table buffer use actual Vec capacities times element size. The public schedule allocation is reported separately. Process RSS, initialization scratch, input-label transfer buffers, allocator overhead, and executable memory are excluded.
garbled_execution.output_policy: All output bytes are opened as public fixtures. Private output sharing is excluded.
garbled_execution.randomness: Fresh OS input labels, global delta, and nonzero session domain for every workload sample. No secret garbling material is reused.
garbled_execution.scope: Actual half-gate execution in separate local OS processes with fixed public fixtures. The evaluator receives bounded table frames through a direct pipe.
garbled_execution.timing_method: Role wall duration excludes schedule parsing and process startup. Gate compute wall duration subtracts measured table read/write time. Scheduling and timer overhead remain; these are not CPU-time or billing estimates.
garbled_execution.transport: Direct child stdout-to-stdin OS pipe; 65,536-byte table frame bound and eight-byte frame headers. These are host measurements, not Cloudflare network measurements.

hash_circuits.count_method: Counts and encodings come from the finalized generator IR and liveness schedule. Half-gate table bytes estimate 32 bytes per AND for 128-bit labels.
hash_circuits.fixed_expand_s_prefix: Each polynomial kernel emits 481 SHAKE256 bytes. Sampling and exceptional prefix exhaustion remain unimplemented. This fixed prefix is not a complete ExpandS algorithm.
hash_circuits.scope: Compiled Boolean hashing kernels and cleartext fixture evaluation. No garbling, oblivious transfer, two-party execution, or secure output sharing occurs.

seed_and_11_polynomial_prefixes.limit: The sum is for hashing alone. IR and schedule bytes describe local compiled artifacts. They are not network payload measurements.

hybrid_key_generation.fixed_prefix_contract: The composition stops if any 481-byte sampler prefix fails. It retains the original canonical seed. A secure retry or continuation protocol remains separate work.
hybrid_key_generation.mask_distribution_limit: A protocol requires independent uniform masks below q. These deterministic public boundary masks check conversion and arithmetic only. Their generation has no entropy or timing claim.
hybrid_key_generation.native_arithmetic_limit: Public-fixture modular reductions and public matrix rejection loops are variable-time reference code. This implementation provides no native constant-time guarantee.
hybrid_key_generation.scope: Complete public-fixture hybrid canonical ML-DSA-65 key generation. Boolean seed expansion, bounded sampling, additive shares, local NTT arithmetic, and Boolean Power2Round compose to the ordinary FIPS encodings.
hybrid_key_generation.security_limit: All fixture seeds, rho-prime values, K values, coefficients, and shares exist in this one process. Boolean execution is cleartext. This composition proves arithmetic interoperability only.

share_shape_per_role.private_polynomial_output_to_b: Sampler and rounding return B residues. This public fixture receives them in cleartext.
share_shape_per_role.public_output: rho and six t1 polynomials, encoded as an ordinary 1952-byte public key.

garbled_execution.input_partition: Each child receives one half of the public bit fixture. This synthetic partition is not a production share-ownership design.
garbled_execution.scope: Separate-process public-fixture half-gates benchmark; open label-pair input transfer provides no privacy.

power2round.mask_formation: Real A masks must be independent uniform canonical residues. Deterministic fixture masks provide no secrecy.
power2round.oracle: Center t modulo8192 into(-4096,4096], then derive high=(t-low)/8192. This scalar oracle does not use the circuit's biased-shift algorithm.
power2round.output_policy: Only public t1 and masked B low shares are circuit outputs. Full t and unmasked t0 remain internal circuit wires.
power2round.scope: Fixed shared-input Power2Round with d=13 and masked additive low outputs. Public synthetic fixtures only.

private_key_generation.scope: Two persistent passive role processes execute one private seed circuit, eleven private sampling circuits, and six private rounding circuits over disposable test keys.
security_limits: This is a shared-host benchmark. File permissions and process separation provide no operating-system isolation claim.
The parent passes each role only public schedule paths, its own seed input path, and its public result path. The normal parent never reads private material files.
An explicitly separate authorized test recipient reconstructs the seed after key generation and then creates the ordinary private key. Every test seed becomes public in this artifact.
The kernels use genuine passive OT and fresh execution domains. Composition privacy remains subject to review.
Local arithmetic has no native constant-time guarantee. Transport authentication, production admission, durable storage, and recipient authorization remain unimplemented.
A bounded sampler failure stops both roles on the same public success bit. Temporary outputs are destroyed. The investigation never changes the canonical seed or retries a different seed.
Host pipes and host wall times do not measure Cloudflare bandwidth, CPU charges, or deployed latency.

private_signing_mask.scope: Separated passive A and B role processes execute private ExpandMask with genuine fresh OT. A receives no decoded output. The parent checks only disposable public-fixture shares after execution.
security_limits: The fixed rhoDoublePrime is public test data. Neither role input file contains both seed shares.
The common parent is an authorized public-fixture test recipient. It reads B's masked output only after both role processes finish.
File permissions and process separation on one host provide no operating-system or Cloudflare isolation claim.
This experiment provides no signing protocol, transport authentication, production admission, durable storage, or reviewed composition proof.
Fresh OT uses the existing classical OT construction. It provides no post-quantum transcript confidentiality claim.
Host pipe timings measure host wall time. They do not measure Cloudflare CPU charges or deployed signing latency.

sampling_and_conversion.failure_contract: Fewer than 256 accepted nibbles returns success=false and zero B-share output. A protocol must destroy all intermediate samples and both output shares on failure. It must retain xi and must not automatically reseed.
